title: People at work (professions)
brief: First batch of the style: create parts/flat-vector/style (palette below) and the generator parts/flat-vector/person (params: pose stand|walk|run|wave|point|think|cheer|talk|sit|hold, expression smile|neutral|open|surprised|sad|angry|laugh, skin 6 tones, hair style + colour, top/bottom/shoes types + colours, hat, accessory, held prop, flip, vx; ~1000 px tall at s 1; facing right). Then one preset part per profession that only fixes outfit, hat, accessory and prop. Generic uniforms only: no real police/army/airline insignia or brand logos.

title: Everyday people, ages and roles
brief: Presets of flat-vector/person (generator exists). Cover ages (child, teen, adult, elder via a body/age param if the generator has one, otherwise add an `age` param to the generator first), families, hobbies, moods and archetypes. Respectful, diverse, no stereotypes.
notes: Added `age` (adult|teen|child|toddler|elder) and prop `cane` to flat-vector/person (v1.1.0, existing presets unchanged). Skipped 'student with backpack' (duplicate of flat-vector/student).

title: Mammals
brief: Create the generator parts/flat-vector/quadruped (body proportions, legs, tail, ears, snout, pattern spots|stripes|none, walk/run/sit/idle, flip, vx) and parts/flat-vector/animal-face for heads, then one preset per species. Recognisable silhouettes and colours; cute but not cartoon-brand-like.
notes: New generators flat-vector/quadruped (proportions, ears, tails, horns, manes, patterns; stand/walk/run/idle/sit/lie/graze) and flat-vector/animal-face (front-facing heads, 7 expressions). 97 quadruped presets; standalone parts for sea mammals (8), apes, sloth, bat, kangaroo, wallaby, meerkat. All 114 names built.

title: Birds, sea life, reptiles and bugs
brief: Generators: parts/flat-vector/bird (perch/fly/flap), parts/flat-vector/fish (swim cycle), parts/flat-vector/bug; then presets. Reptiles may get their own small generator.
notes: New generators flat-vector/bird (10 beaks, crests, combs, fan/train tails, stand/walk/hop/peck/perch/fly/glide/swim/idle), flat-vector/fish (shapes, hammer/bill/whisker heads, puffed), flat-vector/bug (side/top view, butterfly/moth/clear/shell wings, glow, jumper legs) and flat-vector/reptile (lizard/croc/snake/coil/turtle bodies). 40 bird, 10 fish, 15 bug, 14 reptile presets; 23 standalone sea creatures, amphibians and crawlers. All 102 names built.

title: Food and drink
brief: Small prop generators where it helps (fruit/round food, plate + dish, cup/glass/bottle, packaged food without brands), then presets. No brand names or logos.
notes: New prop generators flat-vector/fruit (8 shapes, textures, stems/calyx/crown, cut halves with pits, roll/bounce/pop), flat-vector/dish (plate/bowl/deepbowl/tray/board/pan/basket/katori with liquid/grains/strands/chunks/leafy/pieces/balls fills, garnish, steam) and flat-vector/drink (mug/cup/teacup/glasses/wine/stemmed/bottle/can/carton/jar/takeaway; liquid, foam, straw, ice, steam, plain labels). 20 fruit, 16 dish and 15 drink presets; 67 standalone foods. Props are hero size at s = 1 (use s 0.2-0.3 beside a person). All 118 names built; no brands, text or logos.

title: Home, furniture and household objects
brief: Furniture and household objects drawn front/side-on, anchored at the base. Generic designs only.
notes: 128 standalone flat-vector home props (no generator). Two size classes: room-scale furniture/appliances/fixtures match a flat-vector person at s = 1 (1 m ≈ 560 px); small handheld items are hero size at s = 1 (use s 0.2-0.3 beside a person). Wall items centre on (x, y) (default y 760); ceiling lights hang from (x, y) (default y 0). Item-specific anims (tick, ring, flicker, glow, on, swing, spin, roll, blow, steam, bubbles, water, sway, open...). 'bowl' not built: covered by flat-vector/dish (vessel bowl, fill none). No brands, logos or text (calendar shows day numbers only).

title: Technology and devices
brief: Devices and tech props; screens can show simple generic UI (no real app logos).
notes: humanoid robot covered by flat-vector/robot-person; bluetooth symbol skipped (trademarked logo); walkman -> portable-cassette-player and polaroid camera -> instant-camera (trademark-free slugs); 'mouse' slug taken by the animal, use computer-mouse; the 7 rebuilt in run 08 (computer-mouse, earbuds, charging-cable, podcast-mic, satellite-dish, cpu-chip, ring-light)

title: Tools, work and industry
brief: Hand tools, power tools and industrial objects.
notes: ladder and toolbox already existed (06); key covered by flat-vector/keys; iron tool covered by flat-vector/iron. Slugs: saw->hand-saw, level->spirit-level, hose->garden-hose, barrier->road-barrier, gloves->work-gloves, goggles->safety-goggles, file tool->metal-file, crane->construction-crane, generator->power-generator, torch flame->flaming-torch, bucket of water->water-bucket, sand bag->sand-bag, cog wheel->gear-pair (interlocking gears), measuring tape->sewing-tape-measure (tailor's tape). Deleted in review, rebuild next run: hand drill (unreadable crank drill), fishing net (looked like a racket), vise (two slabs, unrecognisable), harvester (did not read as a combine). Run 2026-11-17 (with 09): rebuilt hand-drill, fishing-net, vise. combine-harvester failed review twice more (read as a tractor with a fan / tall box with a pinwheel) – orchestrator should draw it directly next time. Run 2026-11-17 (with 10): combine-harvester drawn directly by the orchestrator (header with reel, feeder, cab, grain tank, unloading pipe).

title: Vehicles and transport
brief: Side-view vehicles with optional wheel spin and vx; generic designs, no logos.
notes: Vehicle convention set by flat-vector/car (reference): side view facing right, wheels on y, params x,y,s,color,color2,anim(none/drive/bob/pop),vx,flip; boats sit on a waterline at y; aircraft anim fly. Skipped: 'tractor vehicle' (flat-vector/tractor exists), 'ev charger' (flat-vector/electric-car-charger), 'kick scooter' (flat-vector/electric-scooter). Slugs: scooter->motor-scooter, jet->private-jet, tank->army-tank, train station sign->station-sign. Deleted in review, rebuild next run: glider (wing and body unreadable after a redraw), go-kart (thin lines, floating steering wheel after a redraw), space shuttle (read as a plain white jet). Redrawn after review: airplane, private-jet, auto-rickshaw, tugboat, harbour-crane (was a tower crane duplicate). Run 2026-11-17 (with 10): rebuilt glider (orchestrator redrew it: diagonal long wings, T-tail), go-kart (orchestrator redrew it), space-shuttle (vertical launch stack with orange tank and boosters).

title: Buildings and places
brief: Generic buildings and landmarks types (not copies of real named landmarks).
notes: Building convention: front elevation standing on y (default 1600), params x,y,s,color,color2,anim(none/pop/lights),flip; ≤1000 px wide, ≤1450 px tall; no words (only 'H'/'P' where named), no red-cross emblem, generic not real landmarks. Skipped as covered: 'lighthouse building' (flat-vector/lighthouse), 'bus shelter' (flat-vector/bus-stop), 'radio tower' (flat-vector/antenna-tower), 'bridge arch' (flat-vector/bridge is an arched bridge). Slugs: tower->watchtower, park bench area->park-corner, monument obelisk->obelisk, colosseum-style arena->ancient-arena, billboard blank->billboard. Deleted in review, rebuild next run: hospital (garbled sign and ambulance bay), stadium (read as a top-down oval with a door), swimming pool (floating diving board, weak), playground (floating bars, sparse), oil rig (read as scaffolding), dam (read as a building next to water), temple (read as a tiered cake, no shikhara), diner (read as a train carriage). Fixed in review: nuclear-plant cooling towers given a real waist. Rebuilt 2026-11-18 (batch 11 run): hospital, stadium, swimming-pool, playground, oil-rig, dam, temple, diner.

title: Nature, plants, landscape and weather
brief: Plants, landscape elements, weather and sky objects.
notes: Nature convention: grounded scenery/props stand on y (1600 scenery, 1560 small props), anim none/pop/sway for plants, flow for water; sky and weather objects are type effect centred on x,y (default y 500); landscape pieces are ~1000 px wide vignettes on y, not full backgrounds. Skipped as covered: 'campfire' (flat-vector/fire-pit), 'egg' (nest has eggs; boiled-egg/fried-egg exist). 'log' is a single fallen log (logs = stack). Deleted in review, rebuild next run: rice paddy (read as a tiered cake), cliff (read as a grey striped building), waterfall (rock was a rounded grey box, read as a water tank). Fixed in review: dead-tree, jungle and playground scaled so nothing touches the frame edge; jungle lianas no longer hang below the ground; playground anim renamed lights -> swing. Run 2026-11-18 (with batch 12): cliff and waterfall rebuilt and kept; rice paddy deleted again (terraces read as a striped rug) – needs a clearer design, e.g. a hillside with stepped curved terraces and planted rows seen at an angle.

title: Backgrounds and settings
brief: Full-frame parametric backgrounds (time of day, weather params) for common settings.
notes: Foundation: flat-vector/backdrop (type background, layer bg) – outdoor sky/land or indoor room generator with time (day/morning/dusk/night) and weather (clear/cloudy/rain/snow/fog/storm); exports Sky, Hills, Mountains, Skyline, TreeLine, Ground, WeatherFx, Window, Room, Lamp, Cloud, Stars, lit, mix, rnd. Every background preset imports it and has time/weather/anim params (weather shows through Window for interiors); centre stage x 220-860, y 1300-1750 kept clear. Note: the check preview draws the style's ground strip over the bottom of backgrounds; in stories use ground:false on shots with a full-frame background. Slugs renamed where a building/scenery part already existed: mall-interior, gym-interior, indoor-pool (swimming pool), police-station-interior, fire-station-interior, cave-interior; playground scene = playground-scene. Deleted in review, rebuild next run: airplane cabin (seat rows tiny at the edges, aisle dominated), car interior (road strip drawn inside the cabin), throne room (throne read as a yellow trophy/cake), podcast studio (too dark, mics too small to read). Fixed in review: moon-surface planet continents were floating in the sky; bus-interior/car-interior passed height instead of h to WeatherFx (rain covered the whole frame).

brief: Original creatures and sci-fi elements; nothing from existing franchises.

brief: Celebrations from many cultures (generic, respectful) and clothing items.

title: Pixel art: style + people
brief: Create parts/pixel-art/style (16-colour palette, crisp square pixels drawn as SVG rects on a 4–8 px grid, shapeRendering crispEdges) and a parts/pixel-art/sprite generator (pixel map strings + palette, 2–4 frame animation), then people presets as small game-style sprites scaled up.

title: Pixel art: animals
brief: Presets using parts/pixel-art/sprite.

title: Pixel art: items and food
brief: Game-inventory style item sprites using parts/pixel-art/sprite.

brief: Tiled backgrounds and scenery (grass, water, brick, sky with clouds, dungeon, city, forest, space) built from tiles.
